This was a long time ago when I stayed with the Jha family...Surendr and Saroj and their sons Amitabh and Rohan. Above them stayed an actress,  Helen. The apartment had two big rooms and between them a large living room leading to the balcony.
I used to go downstairs with the Jha's son Amitabh to get "Bhel Puri" sold by a hawker near Sophia College. I loved it as I loved "Pani Puri" and "Batata Puri" which I are with the Jhas in downtown Bombay (as it was known then).
The college girls were beautiful and very friendly. Some even came to visit me ...I told the guard to let them in.
Like I said, it was a long time ago and now it all remains as fond memories. I loved my trip to India.
